hook.name: VortaHook
hook.description: Shared Uniswap v4 hook for the Vorta pre-IPO trading platform. Gates pool initialization, liquidity, and trading via a configurable launch time and admin enable flag. Supports an optional Merkle-proof allowlist during early access, a dynamic LP fee decaying from a high launch fee to a base fee, a per-swap protocol fee routed to a fee recipient, and a per-pool TWAP oracle with daily checkpoints for expiry settlement.
